svg.title: reBot-DevArm platform architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram. Host stack (Host PC · SDK, ROS 2, policies, UI · no Performance Level claim): motorbridge Python SDK, ROS 2 driver and MoveIt 2, Pinocchio kinematics, Authenticated command paths, Session lock, pinned builds, Motion-imminent warning, Camera default-off, LeRobot policy, outside every safety function. Controller safety layer (Dedicated controller or hardened SDK (DQ-020) · the first channel of the limit functions): Command validation: finite, bounded, fresh, Watchdog and heartbeat, Mode machine OFF · IDLE · TEACH · RUN · ESTOP, Per-joint position, torque, speed clamps, Contact detection by torque estimation, Encoder plausibility, bus-off reaction. Safety-related control system (PL d target · ISO 13849-1 · nothing in software can hold the contactor closed): Two-channel E-stop on the pendant, Safety relay with monitored reset, Contactor with mirror contact on the 24 V motor supply, Gripper and joints hold on power loss (TBC), Enabling device for teach mode, Fuse and lockable disconnect. A cross-cutting safety and assurance column of draft work products applies to every layer: Machine limits and risk assessment, Safety functions and required PL, SRP/CS architecture and PL calculation, Stopping, holding, separation and E-stop validation, Cybersecurity threat assessment, Safety case and technical file, Decision register and gates. Legend: Inherited, functional only; Hardened by the fork (proposed); To be built, PL d target; Proposed, not yet in any repository.
